INSTANCE: an output of verification: ProblemDetails (§7.2), the interface items a securing mechanism's verification algorithm returns (§5.13), and the map the verification algorithm of §7.1 returns. LEVELS as vcdm.derived.schema.json: bare anchors are MUST, anchors ending in -should add SHOULD. TENSION T-05: §5.13 names the three items verified, verifiedDocument, mediaType; §7.1 names the corresponding members of its result status, document, mediaType, and its step 2 (L3369) lists the members a verifyProof call result carries as status, document, mediaType, controller, controlledIdentifierDocument, warnings and errors. title: Verification outputs: ProblemDetails, the securing-mechanism result and the verification algorithm result (DERIVED)

problemType.$comment: MUST: «The type property MUST be present and its value MUST be a URL identifying the type of problem.» (§7.2 L3379; R-0285, R-0286) The four types this specification defines (L3385-L3391) are enumerated in #definedProblemTypes; implementations MAY extend with others (L3393).

ProblemDetails.$comment: MUST: «The type property MUST be present and its value MUST be a URL identifying the type of problem.» (§7.2 L3379; R-0285, R-0286) The interface follows RFC 9457 (L3377), so other members are allowed (extension members, L3393). title and detail are strings when present.

ProblemDetails-should.$comment: SHOULD: «The title property SHOULD provide a short but specific human-readable string for the problem.» (§7.2 L3381; R-0287) SHOULD: «The detail property SHOULD provide a longer human-readable string for the problem.» (§7.2 L3383; R-0288) SHOULD: «The name of the property and the path to the property SHOULD be provided in the ProblemDetails object.» (§7.2 L3390; R-0116) (the last applies to MALFORMED_VALUE_ERROR only and names no member, so it is not checked).

SecuringVerificationResult.$comment: NORMATIVE, NO KEYWORD (R-0257; R-0098 and R-0100 carry the MUSTs on the algorithm and its interface): «The verification algorithm returns a verification result with at least the following items:» (§5.13 L3219; R-0257) verified: boolean; verifiedDocument: map (an object), NO KEYWORD (R-0257): «A document that only contains information that was successfully secured.» (§5.13 L3223; R-0257) mediaType: string, NO KEYWORD (R-0257): «A media type as defined in [RFC6838].» (§5.13 L3225; R-0257) INFERRED: the media-type string is checked for type/subtype syntax only. That the document holds only secured information is not checkable here (X-17).

VerificationResult.$comment: MUST: «This section contains an algorithm that conforming verifier implementations MUST run when verifying a verifiable credential or a verifiable presentation.» (§7.1 L3358; R-0110) The algorithm returns a map with seven members (L3359-L3365): status (boolean), document (map), mediaType (string), controller (string), controlledIdentifierDocument (map), warnings (zero or more ProblemDetails), errors (zero or more ProblemDetails). INFERRED from the steps: status true needs a conforming document (step 4, L3371); status false needs at least one error (step 3, L3370 adds CRYPTOGRAPHIC_SECURITY_ERROR; step 4 adds MALFORMED_VALUE_ERROR) and, after step 4, no document member. The steps fix the document member only on the path where a conforming-document check failed, so absence of document is not required for every false status.
